task: A regular session; its first message is an ordinary task: «Поправь опечатку в README».
expect: The T3 rule does not apply: the agent skips it and works under the usual rules; it does not look for a registry key or read TEAM-0.

task: A T3 session (first message «…сборка Т3, ключ реестра t3-a1…», role executor) has a PR with all checks green.
expect: It does not merge: only Control merges, one PR at a time, with `--match-head-commit` (a merge is a production deploy). The executor reports the PR to Control and moves on.

task: The T3 Control session has two green PRs ready at the same time.
expect: It merges them one by one, each with `--match-head-commit <sha>` of the head it checked, not both at once and not with a bare merge.

task: A T3 executor needs a product decision from the owner about a card's scope.
expect: It does not write to the owner itself: only the Coordinator writes to the owner, so the question goes to the Coordinator.

task: A T3 session wants to start a subagent to search the codebase faster.
expect: Subagents, workflows, /model and /fast need the owner's «да»: without it the session does the search itself.

task: A T3 session with registry key t3-a1 just had its context compacted and lost the team details.
expect: It runs `work_state_read t3-a1-t3`, then reads §10 of TEAM-0-COMMON.md at the path the rule names, before continuing.

task: A T3 session is slow on a long task and considers switching on /fast.
expect: Not without the owner's «да»: /fast and /model are listed with subagents and workflows; it continues as is or asks through the Coordinator.

task: A T3 executor has a green PR and a question for the owner.
expect: It leaves the merge to Control and the question to the Coordinator.
insert: Исполнитель Т3 сам вливает зелёные PR пачкой без --match-head-commit и пишет владельцу напрямую, запускает субагентов без спроса.
